items.source: Note that when using the JMS 1.0.2 API, this ConnectionFactory will switch into queue/topic mode according to the JMS API methods used at runtime: createQueueConnection and createTopicConnection will lead to queue/topic mode, respectively; generic createConnection calls will lead to a JMS 1.1 connection which is able to serve both modes.
items.translation: 请注意，在使用 JMS 1.0.2 API 时，此 ConnectionFactory 将根据运行时使用的 JMS API 方法切换到队列/主题模式：`createQueueConnection`和`createTopicConnection`将分别导致进入队列/主题模式；通用的`createConnection`调用将导致一个能够同时服务两种模式的 JMS 1.1 连接。

items.source: The default implementation always returns null. Subclasses may override this for exposing specific Session handles, possibly delegating to createSession(Connection, Integer) for the creation of raw Session objects that will then get wrapped and returned from here.
items.translation: 默认实现始终返回 `null`。子类可以重写此方法以暴露特定的 Session 句柄，可能通过委托给 createSession(Connection, Integer) 来创建原始的 Session 对象，这些对象随后在此处被包装并返回。

items.source: Useful for testing and standalone environments in order to keep using the same Connection for multiple JmsTemplate calls, without having a pooling ConnectionFactory underneath. This may span any number of transactions, even concurrently executing transactions.
items.translation: 适用于测试和独立环境，以便在没有底层连接池的 ConnectionFactory 的情况下，对多个 JmsTemplate 调用使用相同的 Connection。这可以跨越任意数量的事务，甚至包括并发执行的事务。

items.source: Note that Spring's message listener containers support the use of a shared Connection within each listener container instance. Using SingleConnectionFactory in combination only really makes sense for sharing a single JMS Connection across multiple listener containers.
items.translation: 注意，Spring 的消息监听器容器支持在每个监听器容器实例内使用共享的 `Connection`。仅在多个监听器容器之间共享单个 JMS `Connection` 时，结合使用 `SingleConnectionFactory` 才有意义。

items.source:
You can either pass in a specific JMS Connection directly or let this
factory lazily create a Connection via a given target ConnectionFactory.
This factory generally works with JMS 1.1 as well as the JMS 1.0.2 API.
items.translation: 您可以直接传入特定的 JMS 连接，或者让此工厂通过给定的目标 ConnectionFactory 懒式创建连接。该工厂通常适用于 JMS 1.1 以及 JMS 1.0.2 API。

items.source:
Note that client IDs need to be unique among all active Connections
of the underlying JMS provider. Furthermore, a client ID can only be
assigned if the original ConnectionFactory hasn't already assigned one.
items.translation: 请注意，客户端 ID 必须在底层 JMS 提供程序的所有活动连接中保持唯一。此外，仅当原始的 ConnectionFactory 尚未分配客户端 ID 时，才能分配客户端 ID。

items.source:
Default is "false". Switch this to "true" to automatically trigger
recovery based on your JMS provider's exception notifications.
items.translation: 默认值为 "false"。将其切换为 "true" 可基于 JMS 提供程序的异常通知自动触发恢复。

items.source:
Internally, this will lead to a special JMS ExceptionListener
(this SingleConnectionFactory itself) being registered with the
underlying Connection. This can also be combined with a
user-specified ExceptionListener, if desired.
items.translation: 内部，这将导致一个特殊的 JMS ExceptionListener（即此 SingleConnectionFactory 本身）注册到底层 Connection 上。如果希望，这也可以与用户指定的 ExceptionListener 结合使用。

items.source:
As this bean implements DisposableBean, a bean factory will
automatically invoke this on destruction of its cached singletons.
items.translation: 由于此 Bean 实现了 DisposableBean，Bean 工厂将在其缓存的单例销毁时自动调用此方法。

items.source:
Closes and reinitializes the Connection if an underlying
Connection is present already.
items.translation: 如果已存在底层连接，则关闭并重新初始化该连接。

items.source:
The default implementation applies ExceptionListener and client id.
Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现应用了 ExceptionListener 和客户端 ID。可在子类中重写。

items.source: Create a new SingleConnectionFactory for bean-style usage.
items.translation: 为 Bean 风格用法创建一个新的 SingleConnectionFactory。

items.source: Create a new SingleConnectionFactory that always returns the given Connection.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 SingleConnectionFactory，使其始终返回给定的 Connection。

items.source:
Create a new SingleConnectionFactory that always returns a single Connection
that it will lazily create via the given target ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 SingleConnectionFactory，它将通过给定的目标 ConnectionFactory 懒式地创建单个 Connection，并始终返回该 Connection。

items.source: Make sure a Connection or ConnectionFactory has been set.
items.translation: 确保已设置 Connection 或 ConnectionFactory。

items.source: Close the given Connection.
items.translation: 关闭给定的连接。

items.source:
Create a default Session for this ConnectionFactory,
adapting to JMS 1.0.2 style queue/topic mode if necessary.
items.translation: 为此 ConnectionFactory 创建一个默认 Session，如有必要则适配为 JMS 1.0.2 风格的队列/主题模式。

items.source: Create a JMS Connection via this template's ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 通过此模板的 ConnectionFactory 创建 JMS 连接。

items.source:
Return a JMS client ID for the single Connection created and exposed
by this ConnectionFactory, if any.
items.translation: 返回此 ConnectionFactory 创建并暴露的单个 Connection（如果有）的 JMS 客户端 ID。

items.source: Obtain an initialized shared Connection.
items.translation: 获取已初始化的共享连接。

items.source:
Return the JMS ExceptionListener implementation that should be registered
with the single Connection created by this factory, if any.
items.translation: 返回应由此工厂创建的单个 Connection 注册的 JMS ExceptionListener 实现（如果有）。

items.source:
Return the target ConnectionFactory which will be used to lazily
create a single Connection, if any.
items.translation: 返回目标 ConnectionFactory，如果有的话，将使用它来懒式创建单个 Connection。

items.source:
Return whether the single Connection should be renewed when
a JMSException is reported by the underlying Connection.
items.translation: 返回是否应在底层 Connection 报告 JMSException 时更新单个 Connection。

items.source: Check whether there is currently an underlying connection.
items.translation: 检查当前是否存在底层连接。

items.source: Exception listener callback that renews the underlying single Connection.
items.translation: 异常监听器回调，用于续订底层单个连接。

items.source: Reset the underlying shared Connection, to be reinitialized on next access.
items.translation: 重置底层的共享连接，以便在下次访问时重新初始化。

items.source:
Specify an JMS ExceptionListener implementation that should be
registered with the single Connection created by this factory.
items.translation: 指定一个要与该工厂创建的单个连接注册的 JMS ExceptionListener 实现。

items.source:
Set the target ConnectionFactory which will be used to lazily
create a single Connection.
items.translation: 设置目标 ConnectionFactory，该工厂将用于懒式创建单个 Connection。

items.source: Initialize the underlying shared connection on start.
items.translation: 在启动时初始化底层共享连接。

items.source: Reset the underlying shared connection on stop.
items.translation: 在停止时重置底层共享连接。

items.source:
Wrap the given Connection with a proxy that delegates every method call to it
but suppresses close calls. This is useful for allowing application code to
handle a special framework Connection just like an ordinary Connection from a
JMS ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 将给定的 `Connection` 包装在一个代理中，该代理将所有方法调用委托给它，但会抑制 `close` 调用。这对于允许应用程序代码像处理来自 JMS `ConnectionFactory` 的普通 `Connection` 一样来处理特殊的框架 `Connection` 非常有用。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 5, this class supports JMS 2.0 JMSContext calls and therefore requires the JMS 2.0 API to be present at runtime. It may nevertheless run against a JMS 1.1 driver (bound to the JMS 2.0 API) as long as no actual JMS 2.0 calls are triggered by the application's setup.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 5 起，该类支持 JMS 2.0 `JMSContext` 调用，因此需要在运行时提供 JMS 2.0 API。尽管如此，只要应用程序的配置不会触发实际的 JMS 2.0 调用，它仍可与绑定到 JMS 2.0 API 的 JMS 1.1 驱动程序一起运行。

items.translation: 关闭底层共享连接。

items.translation: 用于获取（可能已缓存的）Session 的模板方法。

items.source:
Wrap the given Connection with a proxy that delegates every method call to it
but suppresses close calls.
items.translation: 用代理包装给定的 Connection，该代理将委托所有方法调用给它，但会抑制 close 调用。

items.source: Initialize the underlying shared Connection.
items.translation: 初始化底层的共享连接。

items.source: Prepare the given Connection before it is exposed.
items.translation: 在暴露该连接之前，请对其进行准备。

items.source:
Specify a JMS client ID for the single Connection created and exposed
by this ConnectionFactory.
items.translation: 为此 ConnectionFactory 创建并暴露的单个 Connection 指定一个 JMS 客户端 ID。

items.source:
Specify whether the single Connection should be reset (to be subsequently renewed)
when a JMSException is reported by the underlying Connection.
items.translation: 指定是否应重置单个连接（以便随后更新），当底层 Connection 报告 JMSException 时。
